sectionTitle: ÔN TẬP PHẦN 4 · DỰNG CÂU - SENTENCE BUILDING
sectionDesc: Bộ đề HOMEWORK môn Anh Văn - Phần 4. Phần này: viết câu hoàn chỉnh dựa trên các từ gợi ý.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Lan / usually / get up / early / morning / go / school / bus.
questions.correctAnswer: Lan usually gets up early in the morning and goes to school by bus.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: my father / work / hospital / near / our house.
questions.correctAnswer: My father works at a hospital near our house.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: the students / often / discuss / their homework / after / class.
questions.correctAnswer: The students often discuss their homework after class.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: last Sunday / we / visit / a famous museum / city center.
questions.correctAnswer: Last Sunday, we visited a famous museum in the city center.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Sarah / not / like / drink / coffee / because / it / taste / bitter.
questions.correctAnswer: Sarah does not like drinking coffee because it tastes bitter.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: my brother / enjoy / play / football / but / he / not / have / much / free time.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother enjoys playing football, but he does not have much free time.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: they / buy / new furniture / for / their apartment / last month.
questions.correctAnswer: They bought new furniture for their apartment last month.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Tom / usually / study / library / because / it / be / quiet.
questions.correctAnswer: Tom usually studies in the library because it is quiet.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: If / you / practice / English / regularly / you / improve / speaking skills.
questions.correctAnswer: If you practice English regularly, you will improve your speaking skills.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: Mai / feel / tired / but / she / continue / work / on / project / tonight.
questions.correctAnswer: Mai feels tired, but she will continue working on the project tonight.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: we / stay / home / because / it / rain / heavily / yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: We stayed at home because it rained heavily yesterday.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: although / John / be / very busy / he / help / his parents / with / housework.
questions.correctAnswer: Although John is very busy, he helps his parents with the housework.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: you / can / take / bus / to university / or / you / ride / bicycle.
questions.correctAnswer: You can take the bus to university, or you can ride a bicycle.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: she / want / buy / new phone / but / she / not / have / enough money.
questions.correctAnswer: She wants to buy a new phone, but she does not have enough money.

questions.title: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh
questions.question: If / the weather / be / nice / tomorrow / we / go / camping / with / friends.
questions.correctAnswer: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will go camping with our friends.

sectionTitle: ÔN TẬP PHẦN 4 · SẮP XẾP CÂU - SENTENCE ORDERING
sectionDesc: Bộ đề HOMEWORK môn Anh Văn - Phần 4. Phần này: sắp xếp các câu (A–E) theo thứ tự đúng để tạo thành một đoạn văn hoàn chỉnh.

questions.question:
A. For example, students can use educational websites to review their lessons.
B. The Internet is a useful tool for students.
C. Therefore, students can use the Internet to support their learning.
D. It gives them access to a large amount of information.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. As a result, they may feel tired during the day.
B. Getting enough sleep is important for students.
C. For example, students who sleep too little may have difficulty concentrating.
D. Therefore, students should develop healthy sleeping habits.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. However, using social media too much can have negative effects.
B. Social media is popular among young people.
C. It allows them to communicate with friends easily.
D. Therefore, young people should use social media responsibly.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

B. Online learning has become popular among university students.
C. In addition, many courses provide recorded lessons.
D. Students can access learning materials from almost anywhere.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

B. University students have many responsibilities.
C. They have to attend classes and complete assignments.
D. They may also take part in social activities.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

C. It can also help reduce stress.
D. Therefore, people should exercise regularly.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

D. It can also reduce stress.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. As a result, more people choose to shop online.

D. In addition, many websites offer home delivery.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

B. Many office workers spend long hours sitting at their desks.
C. As a result, they may experience physical discomfort.
D. Therefore, they should take regular breaks.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. For instance, students can join clubs or volunteer in community activities.
B. Making new friends can be easy at university.
C. These activities give them opportunities to meet new people.
D. Therefore, joining social activities can help students build relationships.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. However, excessive use of technology can cause problems.
B. Technology has changed the way people work and communicate.
C. For example, too much screen time may cause eye strain.
D. Therefore, people should use technology responsibly.
